title: dapilot stage marker
description: work/<sha256>/<stage>.<status>.json, written only by the ledger. failed and blocked stop the item: no run dispatches the stage again until the marker is cleared (ledger.py retry, or a person). review stops nothing: the stage is done and a check found something to look at. The file is the fact; every run reads it the same way.

question.description: blocked: what the stage asked a person

worker_log.description: the director's transcript of the attempt, under runs/<run>/workers/

error.description: the script's own code for the failure, e.g. config.key_rejected

clear.description: a sentence for a person: how to let a run take the stage up again

note.description: a sentence for a person: what a review marker means
